title: Apartment Design 64 m² in Kraków, minimalist
description: 64 m² minimalist apartment in Kraków: design project, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed a design project for a 64 m² apartment in a contemporary minimalist style. The concept is founded on functionality, the understated architecture of the space, a calm color scheme, and the visual cohesion of the interior.

The interior features neutral gray tones, clean lines, and minimalist forms. The restrained palette creates a calm backdrop for the interior, while the combination of different textures and materials makes the space expressive without excessive decorative elements.

Particular attention was paid to architectural details. Hidden doors without trim are integrated flush into the walls, reinforcing the minimalist character of the interior. Understated furniture solutions and built-in elements preserve the clean geometry of the rooms and make efficient use of the available floor area.

The layout and interior solutions were developed with ergonomics and everyday comfort in mind. Every element of the interior is part of an overall composition, so the apartment is perceived as a single contemporary space.
The project includes the development of the interior concept, photorealistic 3D visualizations, and the technical documentation required for subsequent implementation of the design solutions.
